newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWIMMING-MEXICAN SWIMMER APPEALS AGANST DOPING BAN.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-MEXICAN SWIMMER APPEALS AGANST DOPING BAN.

text.p: Mexican synchronised swimmer Perla Ramierez has appealed against her two-year suspension for the use of a banned diuretic, the international swimming federation (FINA) said on Monday.
Ramierez was banned by the Mexican Swimming Federation two weeks ago after she tested positive at the French Open in March.
"She presented an appeal to FINA last week," said spokesman Cornel Marculescu. "We must now determine how to proceed."
Ramierez was in the Mexican team at the Atlanta Olympics but did not compete when officials became concerned her participation might have sparked protests.
